notice: Historical cyclone track proximity only; not observed damage, wind impact or a future forecast.

method.distance: Minimum great-circle distance to any segment of each storm's complete LineString track, in kilometres.
method.count: One encounter per unique stormId per community when distance is within the selected radius.
method.eligibility: Only systems with BoM TYPE T (tropical cyclone) are included; TYPE L, E and O are excluded.
method.year: Storm start year; ranges are inclusive.
method.ranking: Encounter count descending, nearest qualifying path distance ascending, community name ascending.
method.missingIntensity: No intensity weighting. Missing wind speed does not change the count.
method.precision: Distances rounded to 0.001 km for filtering; source positions have lower practical accuracy.
